entities.summary: Shahina K. K., alternatively KK Shahina or Shahina Nafeesa, is a veteran Indian journalist who has worked across print and broadcast media to shed light on issues such as gender, human rights, and marginalized communities, along with the injustices they face. She is a Senior Editor Outlook magazine, and a contributor for The Washington Post. She is among the four winners of the 2023 CPJ International Press Freedom Awards. She is the fourth Indian to achieve this recognition. She was conferred with the Chameli Devi Jain Award for Outstanding Women Mediapersons in 2011.
